sentences.en: Algeria is at the same latitude as Washington DC.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚和华盛顿特区处于相同的纬度。

sentences.en: Please give me some latitude this time.
sentences.zh: 这次请给我一些灵活性。

sentences.en: The horse latitudes are subtropical regions known for calm winds and little precipitation.
sentences.zh: 马纬度是著名的少风且降水稀少的亚热带区域。
